_howToAddAnEvent: Add an object to the list below, then run: node sites/williscooper/build-events.mjs — that regenerates the event cards and the search-engine data inside events.html. Required: title, type, date. accent picks the colour stripe (teal, blue, plum, gold, rose). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. An event greys itself out automatically once its date has passed; you never need to mark it 'completed' by hand.
